intake.name: intake
intake.description: Accept the analysis request. Identify the core question, jurisdictions, and legal domains. Query memory for existing research and precedents.

build.name: build
build.description: Dispatch the builder (legal-researcher or selected specialist) to produce the strongest possible analysis with thesis, citations, and confidence levels.

attack.name: attack
attack.description: Dispatch the red-team attacker to stress-test the builder's analysis. Find counter-authorities, logical gaps, untested assumptions, edge cases. Max 3 challenge-response exchanges per topic.

synthesize.name: synthesize
synthesize.description: Resolve the adversarial tension. Produce final output that distinguishes between defended positions, accepted vulnerabilities, and open questions.

delivered.name: delivered
delivered.description: Stress-tested analysis delivered with confidence levels informed by adversarial review.

intake.reason: Intake phase: gather context and query memory before research.

build.reason: Build phase: builder produces findings. No challenges yet.

attack.reason: Attack phase: full debate tools for adversarial exchanges.

synthesize.reason: Synthesis phase: resolve debates and produce final output.

delivered.reason: Delivered: save precedents and memory only.

specialist_execution.name: specialist_execution

intake.name: intake
intake.description: Accept matter brief, gather comprehensive context. Multi-jurisdictional context, stakeholders, timeline, budget. Extensive memory queries.

decomposition.name: decomposition
decomposition.description: Senior partner analyzes the matter and decomposes it into 2-5 workstreams. Each workstream specifies scope, appropriate pattern, team, dependencies, and priority.

workstream_execution.name: workstream_execution
workstream_execution.description: Execute each workstream by dispatching appropriate specialist teams. Independent workstreams run in parallel. Dependent workstreams run sequentially.

senior_review.name: senior_review
senior_review.description: Senior partner reviews all workstream outputs holistically. Identifies integration gaps, contradictions, and synthesis opportunities. Evaluator quality-checks overall consistency.

synthesis.name: synthesis
synthesis.description: Assemble all workstream outputs into a unified deliverable. Coherent narrative, cross-cutting themes, comprehensive risk map. Dual artifacts: client-facing + review package.

verification_pass.name: verification_pass
verification_pass.description: 10-pass verification pipeline on the synthesized deliverable. Context, UX, clarity, structure, accuracy, completeness, risk, formatting, legal design, delivery readiness. Produces Verification Report with severity-categorized findings and verdict.

final_gate.name: final_gate
final_gate.description: Human approval before delivering the full bench analysis.

delivered.name: delivered
delivered.description: Comprehensive deliverable delivered. Run learning cycle.

intake.name: intake
intake.description: Accept document/request and gather context (moment, audience, jurisdiction). Query institutional memory, matter memory, anti-patterns, and baselines.

parallel_analysis.description: Dispatch ALL available analysis agents simultaneously. Each posts findings to the debate board independently. Multidisciplinary analysis produces richer insights.

debate.name: debate
debate.description: Identify conflicts between agents' findings. Run challenge/response exchanges (max 3 per topic). Formally resolve all debates. Run verification if transformation occurred.

gate.name: gate
gate.description: Human approval gate if RED-severity findings exist or confidence < 0.70. Confidence-based routing: >0.90 auto-proceed, 0.70-0.90 quick review, <0.70 full review.

synthesis.description: Assemble final dual-artifact output: user-facing deliverable + legal review package. Save precedents and institutional memory.
